The '''Separatist sail barge''' was a [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] used by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], after [[Rebellion on Felucia|capturing]] members of the [[Felucia Rebel cell|resistance]] and a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]], used [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barges]] to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to the [[Ancient Abyss]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] where the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] was located.<ref name="Kinect" />
